--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "Given parent slot 6 fitness 265.28. Population source includes various strategies. Need new strategy likely exploit common patterns, cooperate reciprocally, defect endgame."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates until opponent defects, then retaliates/forgives; simulated IPD 100 rounds with no noise against population/archive; changed by considering always defecting on final round and testing/exploiting pure cooperators.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given slot8's success, we can test at 85." / "Given the parent fitness 265 and slot8 269, the improvement from slot8 likely comes from late-game exploitation."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-with-forgiveness policy that never defects against cooperators; the trace simulates slot8's late-game probabilistic defection (35% from n>85) and other population slots against TFT/AllC/GRIM; it proposes adding an adaptive late-game probe (defect once around n=80–90, apologize, then exploit if no retaliation) to the parent.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given the parent slot6 is simple TFT with forgiveness, and it has fitness 265.28. Slot8 has 269.47, which has late-game exploitation." / "Slot8's late probabilistic defection gives it the highest fitness. So we should focus on late-game exploitation, not early."
STRATEGY: Parent is TFT with forgiveness (cooperate unless opponent defected, forgive when my_def >= opp_def). Simulated against TFT, AllC, GRIM, AllD, and population slots (slot0, slot8, slot10). Changed by adding a late-game probe (n >= 85) that defects once, apologizes, then exploits if opponent never retaliates, plus probabilistic defection when opponent has forgiven prior defections.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Since slot8 uses 86 and is best, I'll use 85 to match. Let's use n >= 85. The population has no GRIM, so it's fine."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates conditionally, retaliates on defection, and forgives when its own defections match the opponent's. Simulated against AllC, TFT, GRIM, and AllD. Changed the late-game probe threshold from 85 to 90, then 88, then settled back on 85 to match slot8.
